//: AIR crafting impact tiers (09.10.2026, reworked the same day): the colour a recipe's name wears in the crafting panel, so the things worth looking at stand out when a skill level is reached. Original Prologue design, computed by src/game/crafting/RecipeImpact.js from the catalogue: score = impact x impactWeight + ease + end, where impact (0..4) is what kind of thing it is (drinking water and the first ranged weapon 4; a staple cooked meal (one thing cooked, water aside, of easy ingredients), a dressing, the best weapon at its level, the first watertight container and a fire starter 3; other cooked food, a new tool quality, other ranged weapons, the best armour, a big container, a light 2; a treat, an ordinary weapon or garment, a tool of a known quality, a staple material 1), ease (0..4) is how easy its ingredients are to come by (the hardest component row at its easiest alternative, from the acquisition evidence, what a seed grows into counting as farmedRank; elaborate recipes of elaborateRows or more rows count one less), and end is +1 for a thing nothing else eats, -1 for an ingredient of intermediateUses or more recipes (food and wound care are spared under stapleMaterialUses uses; past it anything is a material first). `thresholds` are the scores each word starts at; `tiers` are overrides that win (ids of recipe results).
